description: Sarah Ho at Karlsruhe Institute of Technology publishes MATLAB scripts and inputs for forecast-based operation of small reservoirs serving flood control, irrigation and low-flow objectives. Version 1.0.1, deposited in November 2025, includes reservoir information, hourly forecasts in MAT files, irrigation-demand inputs and tutorials. The application data cover Baden-Württemberg, Germany; a California Central Valley crop map is included only for tutorial use. MATLAB 2023a or newer and Mapping Toolbox are required, with ArcMap or QGIS for parts of the tutorial. The deposit is free under CC BY 4.0; MATLAB licensing is separate. It supports simulation and comparison of reservoir operating decisions using forecast information. Exact simulation dates and spatial resolution remain unknown from the public description. The associated HESS paper was described as under review, and execution was not checked. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified; the provider links it as a variant of the earlier reservoir-reuse model at Zenodo 15705911.
